topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe I'm stuck in this again. Of course, they lied. They always do, don't they? It's like the world is just one big puppet show, and we're all supposed to clap along like we don't see the strings. But I see them. I saw this coming from a mile away. Yet, here we are, picking up the pieces, pretending to be surprised when we all know it's just another day. What was I supposed to do, applaud their performance? No. I have better things to do than play along with this charade.
